name: code-review-extension
description: Git Code Review - a code review workspace for reviewers inside VS Code.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:eslint && npm run arch:depcruise && npm run arch:madge
scripts.test:mutation: npm run test:mutation:domain && npm run test:mutation:core && npm run test:mutation:analyzers
scripts.test:mutation:core: npm run test:mutation:core:use-cases && npm run test:mutation:core:services-ai && npm run test:mutation:core:shared
scripts.test:mutation:core:use-cases: npm run test:mutation:core:use-cases:ai && npm run test:mutation:core:use-cases:ast && npm run test:mutation:core:use-cases:rag && npm run test:mutation:core:use-cases:review && npm run test:mutation:core:use-cases:sync-vps
scripts.test:mutation:core:use-cases:review: npm run test:mutation:core:use-cases:review:pr && npm run test:mutation:core:use-cases:review:workspace && npm run test:mutation:core:use-cases:review:reporting && npm run test:mutation:core:use-cases:review:session
scripts.test:mutation:core:use-cases:review:anal: npm run test:mutation:core:use-cases:review:pr && npm run test:mutation:core:use-cases:review:workspace && npm run test:mutation:core:use-cases:review:reporting
scripts.test:mutation:performance:core:dry-run: npm run test:mutation:performance:core:dry-run:review:pr && npm run test:mutation:performance:core:dry-run:review:workspace && npm run test:mutation:performance:core:dry-run:review:reporting && npm run test:mutation:performance:core:dry-run:review:session
scripts.test:mutation:performance:core:dry-run:r: npm run test:mutation:performance:core:dry-run:review:pr && npm run test:mutation:performance:core:dry-run:review:workspace && npm run test:mutation:performance:core:dry-run:review:reporting
scripts.quality:fast: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test:unit
scripts.quality:release: npm run quality:fast && npm run quality:llm && npm run quality:rag && npm run quality:ide
scripts.test:all: npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:coverage && npm run build
scripts.test:full: npm run test:all && npm run test:mutation
scripts.quality: rm -rf .stryker-tmp coverage mutation-report && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:runtime && npm run test:mutation:domain && npm run test:mutation:core:use-cases && npm run test:mutation:core:services-ai && npm run test:mutation:core:shared && npm run test:mutation:analyzers
scripts.preflight:vscode: npm run clean && npm install && npm run typecheck --workspace git-code-review && npm run build --workspace git-code-review && npm run test:smoke --workspace git-code-review && npm run package:vscode
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/vscode/node_modules packages/*/node_modules dist apps/vscode/dist apps/vscode/out apps/vscode/meta.json apps/vscode/*.vsix
scripts.production:gate: npm run typecheck --workspace git-code-review && npm run test:production --workspace git-code-review && npm run build --workspace git-code-review && npm run package:vscode && npm run validate:vsix --workspace git-code-review && npm run audit:critical
scripts.product:release: npm run typecheck --workspace git-code-review && npm run test:production --workspace git-code-review && npm run build --workspace git-code-review && npm run package:vscode && npm run validate:vsix --workspace git-code-review && npm run product:ready && npm run audit:critical
